definition: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON: sorted keys, no whitespace, unescaped Unicode. Resolve cumulative schema-2 atom catalogs. Each record retains full_atoms, shown_atoms, shown_terms sorted by canonical JSON, plus costs. Sort records by canonical JSON; preserve duplicate model/shown occurrences; omit record numbers.
scope: Native qualification captures only; additional before/after audit, not a correctness proof or a comparison of clingo hidden models. Maintained reports check repeats separately.
